item: An exclusive operation's hold now reaches a Run-now pass in flight and every way the collection loop starts
refs: R367; findings F2 and F5 of the read of #1607; PR #1617
summary: stop() returned before signalling anything when the loop was not running, so a Run-now pass was never asked to wind down and a restore's wait spent its full bound on it; start() ignored the hold, so the Start button, going online and the unattended start restarted the loop mid-import. A pass-scoped stop event is set by stop() only while a pass is in flight and the loop is not running, and cleared at the start of every pass; start() is refused while the hold stands (the refusal is remembered and the operation's resume honours it, so a Start or go-online pressed mid-import is delayed, never lost; the hold check and the thread creation share one lock region), the operation's resume releases the hold before its start attempts, and status() carries exclusive_hold. Changed behaviour stated: a Stop while a Run-now pass is in flight now winds that pass down. Thirteen tests, seven red before.
